newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bourse announces PX50 re-shuffle of issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech bourse announces PX50 re-shuffle of issues.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Thursday that eight issues would be removed from the official PX50 index and eight added in their place with effect from July 1, 1997.

NOTE: The bourse said in a statement that only companies from the main or parallel markets that were among the 80 most heavily traded shares on the central market of the PSE in the last six months and which are among the 100 companies with the greatest market capitalisation would be elgible to be listed on the PX50.
The PSE added that the next round of changes would come on January 1, 1998.
